question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown having alphabets 'G' to 'L'. Find the alphabet on the face opposite the face showing 'K'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/830c4499f0ecf077130fefa6e59ed57b8e0fdad39e62cf309288275317d51a39.png]
solution:
As per the given figure:

In the given dice position, the alphabet H and I are common, which means K is opposite to L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7791f78a8104bc5157483e4f01afea44e6b110146d0b47af3022caa258cae514.png] 

Here, alphabet L is opposite to the K.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".
